step1.title: Readiness check
step1.description: Confirm the panel API is ready before continuing.
step1.apiReadyDesc: The setup endpoint is reachable and the panel is ready to be configured.
step1.infoNote: Setup will create your administrator account, organization, and first node.

step2.title: Create the administrator
step2.description: This account will have full control over the panel.
step2.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, different from your email.

errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.tooShort: Password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.sameAsEmail: Password must be different from your email.

step3.title: Create your organization
step3.description: Name the company or team this panel serves.
step3.heading: Organization
step3.subheading: Servers are grouped under one organization during setup.
step3.orgHint: Shown in the header and invoices. You can rename it later.

step4.title: Configure your first node
step4.description: The node is the machine that runs your servers.
step4.heading: Node configuration
step4.subheading: This machine will be registered as the first node on the panel.
step4.nameHint: A short label identifying this machine.
step4.fqdnHint: The hostname the panel and wings use to reach this node.

step5.title: Configure email delivery
step5.description: SMTP is optional and can be configured later.
step5.heading: SMTP settings
step5.subheading: Used for password resets and account notifications.
step5.hostHint: Leave empty to skip email setup for now.

step6.title: Choose a backup destination
step6.heading: Backup destination
step6.subheading: Backups are stored locally unless you select S3.

step7.title: Set up the panel domain
step7.description: This domain serves the panel and its certificates.
step7.heading: Domain and TLS
step7.subheading: A valid domain is required to issue TLS certificates.
step7.domainHint: Point a DNS record at this machine before continuing.
step7.tlsEmailHint: Used for Let's Encrypt expiry notices.
step7.tlsInfo: A Let's Encrypt certificate will be issued automatically after setup.

step8.title: Setup complete
step8.description: The panel is ready to use.
step8.readyOutro: is ready. Sign in to manage servers, nodes, and teams.
